features.quote: West of the village is a family grave from the Roman Period
features.subtype: built family tomb, 9x9 m, burial chamber with coffin niches

mouth.phrase: next to the structure are two cisterns

date.basis: entry dates the family grave to the Roman Period

features.quote: next to the structure are two cisterns
features.subtype: two cisterns beside the family grave

notes: No plan in the entry. s2f2: a built tomb with an entrance hall, burial chamber and niches for coffins; coded cavity_with_opening true as a chamber tomb with niches (closest to kokhim), though it is built, not rock-cut. s2f3: the two cisterns are next to the tomb, which is west of the village, so W from the site; they may be among the 30 of s2f1. Mouth: the entry says the cisterns are next to the tomb structure ('next to'), recorded as a mouth phrase linking s2f2 to s2f3.
